source: Actual run 2026-09-22: pinned Claude Code 2.1.257, runtime.claude_profile.command(writable=False) plus --json-schema, with MODEL substituted by the release selection claude-opus-5. Synthetic fixture, no project material. The init row is reduced mechanically to the fields runtime.provider_result.parse reads; absolute local paths, the messaging socket and unrelated rows are omitted. Raw events stay in the private evidence root.
why: The qualification premise this file exists to make checkable: that the pinned CLI echoes an explicitly selected --model value VERBATIM into system/init.model, and that the review role inventory is unchanged under it. If the CLI normalised or aliased the name, every Claude run under a selection would fail the identity check while still spending a call. Measured, not assumed.
